Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Vânzări cu amănuntul
We are hiring a Senior Product QA engineer for our Member and Communications team. You will work on product quality from requirements through release. You will test new features in the test environments, then turn the checks that matter into automated UI and API tests, and help the team agree on a shared, risk-based test strategy.
 We use AI in our daily work, and we’re heading towards fully automated QA in the product area. As one of our product QAs, you’ll help design that AI-driven quality system and be part of the strategy.
 About the team 
Every time a shopper opens a Lobyco-powered loyalty app, gets a push notification, or reads a personalized banner, our Member & Communications team is behind it. Millions of members across 10 markets, and growing.
Our team looks after identity and member management, in-app communications, and workflow orchestration parts that send personalized communications. Lobyco Nexus is a loyalty and promotions platform, so nothing here runs alone. One promotion can change a member’s balance, trigger a real-time journey, and land as a message in the member’s app, under different rules in each market.
That’s the testing challenge: how these features work together inside retail workflows, and how a change shows up for end users and for the retailers who depend on us. With that scale comes responsibility, so you’ll learn how our products are used and how they are surfaced for both the people in the app and for the businesses running on it.
 What you will do 
Test new features and bug fixes: get familiar with the feature and the linked pull request, decide what to test, and run it on test environments.
Test below the screen too: call the services directly and check the data they store and the events they publish, not only what the UI shows.
Write and maintain test cases in Azure DevOps Test Plans.
Automate regression checks in our shared Kotlin framework: Selenide for the admin tool, REST Assured for the APIs, and Appium for the member apps.
Keep the nightly pipelines green. Triage failures, tell product bugs apart from test or environment issues, and fix flaky tests.
File clear, reproducible bugs with the right severity, and verify the fixes.
Add coverage where we need it most.
Work with AI every day. We use Claude Code with shared QA skills to read a ticket's linked pull requests, draft test conditions, write and debug automated tests, and triage failed runs.
Review tests that developers write with AI. You check that they assert the right thing, cover the risky paths and follow our framework conventions.
Improve the AI tooling itself. When the assistant gets something wrong, you fix the prompt, skill or project instructions so the next run gets it right.
Run exploratory and regression checks with our AI QA assistant, which drives the admin tool on PRE and records evidence such as screenshots and traces.
 What we expect 
3+ years in software QA, testing web applications and REST APIs.
1+ year writing automated tests in code, ideally Kotlin or Java. Strong automation experience in another language is fine if you are willing to switch to Kotlin.
Hands-on experience with a UI automation tool (Selenium, Selenide, Playwright or Cypress) and with API testing (REST Assured, Postman or similar).
Solid test design: equivalence classes, boundary values, state transitions, and a clear sense of what is not worth testing.
A working understanding of HTTP, JSON, auth tokens, and browser developer tools.
Comfortable with Git and pull requests. You can read a code diff and work out what it changes.
You work independently in a distributed team and raise problems early.
Hands-on use of an AI coding assistant (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar) in your testing or automation work, and the habit of checking what it produces before you trust it.
 Nice to have 
Kotlin, TestNG and Gradle.
Azure DevOps (Boards, Test Plans, Pipelines) or a similar CI/CD setup.
Testing sign-up and login flows built on OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
Mobile app testing on iOS and Android, including Appium.
Testing asynchronous systems: message queues (Azure Service Bus), background jobs, email and push delivery.
Microservices on Azure, and reading logs in Application Insights.
Retail, loyalty or e-commerce products.
ISTQB Foundation certificate.
 Your new workplace 
 Your new workplace is the Lobyco Hub centrally placed in Bucharest. We are a social bunch of people and expect you to take part in the office culture. We have weekly breakfast in the office and other social gatherings. We have an informal tone and a flat hierarchy, and you have the opportunity to impact how we work.
 Curious for more? Have a look at our website/LinkedIn etc. You can also contact Product Lead Sebastian Tatu, Sebastian.tatu@lobyco.com
 We will evaluate applications as they come in, so send your application sooner rather than later.
 Born from retail, with the DNA of the shop floor, we exist to bring retailers and customers closer together by making loyalty easy, personal, and impactful. 
 We’re here to reinvent retail by empowering retailers with the tools to deliver personalized, digital-first experiences that grow loyalty, increase engagement, and drive long-term value for both businesses and shoppers. 
 Our pride lies not just in our platform, but in our people retail-savvy, highly skilled teams who thrive on co-creating success with clients to make loyalty come alive in their business. 
 We aim to be diverse in all manners when getting new people onboard in our journey, and therefore encourage applications from all backgrounds, communities and industries
